title: Timber-concrete beam response
independent_unit: Whole beam; six beams in two concrete classes
timing_contract: Given current imposed displacement, concrete class, and beam-specific initial force-displacement calibration prefix through≤10mm; no later force or failure capacity allowed.
scope_limits: Four development beams and two confirmation beams. Header audit exposed confirmation first11points (all below10mm); these are permitted calibration only. All late damage rows retained.
primary_metric: Mean over independent groups of within-group mean absolute physical-unit error. Equal groups.
selection: Minimum development grouped MAE; models within1% of best prefer fewer free parameters. Baselines eligible. Confirmation cannot select or revise.
stopping: At least5substantive attempts; thereafter two consecutive distinct attempts failing ≥1% primary improvement or improved worst-group error/identified simplification; no confirmation feedback.
fitting: Group-balanced bounded nonlinear least squares; fixed deterministic starts. Flexible baseline fixed ridge or nonlinear low-dimensional logistic. All fits within applicable training folds.
confirmation: Separate confirm.py checks frozen all states/code hashes; no fit or selection.

exposure.audit: Four development beams and two confirmation beams. Header audit exposed confirmation first11points (all below10mm); these are permitted calibration only. All late damage rows retained.

uncertainty: Individual experimental group errors; no row bootstrap or population CI from dependent rows.
